name: Whitney Houston
hook: A gospel singer's daughter from Newark whose 1992 recording of Dolly Parton's 'I Will Always Love You' spent fourteen weeks at number one.
blurb: Whitney Houston was born in Newark, New Jersey, on 9 August 1963. Her mother, Cissy Houston, was a gospel and soul singer, Dionne and Dee Dee Warwick were her cousins, Darlene Love was her godmother, and Aretha Franklin was a family friend she called an aunt. Wikipedia names her mother as her biggest influence, Dionne Warwick for how to perform on stage, and Aretha Franklin, Chaka Khan, Gladys Knight, Roberta Flack and Karen Carpenter among others. She sang in the choir of Newark's New Hope Baptist Church from the age of five and began singing backup for her mother in Manhattan clubs at fourteen. Clive Davis signed her to Arista Records at 19. Her first two albums, 'Whitney Houston' (1985) and 'Whitney' (1987), topped the American chart for 14 and 11 weeks, helped by MTV airplay that was then rarely given to Black artists. For the 1992 film 'The Bodyguard' she recorded Dolly Parton's country song 'I Will Always Love You' as a huge pop ballad. It spent a then-record fourteen weeks at number one and won Record of the Year. In 2001 she signed a new deal with Arista reported at $100 million, while her drug use and her marriage to Bobby Brown were damaging her public image. She died at the Beverly Hilton hotel on 11 February 2012, aged 48. The Los Angeles County coroner ruled it an accidental drowning in the bathtub, with heart disease and cocaine use contributing.
